# Herb-crumb baked cod with lemon couscous and cucumber salad

Cod is one of the lower-potassium fish: about 207 mg in 3 oz cooked, against about 330 mg for salmon. Fresh breadcrumbs made from white bread, butter, dill and garlic powder make a crisp topping without the sodium of shop-bought seasoned crumbs.

**Serves 4** · 30 minutes · Lower potassium · Lower phosphorus · Dialysis-friendly

!!! abstract "Carbohydrate per serving"
    **40 g carbohydrate** (about 2½ carb choices of 15 g). Most of it comes from the couscous and the crumbs. For about 55 g, add ¼ cup more couscous (9 g) and ½ cup of strawberries for dessert (6 g).

## Ingredients

| Ingredient | Amount | Grams |
|---|---|---|
| Cod, Atlantic, cooked | 4 cod fillets, about 12 oz cooked (about 1 lb raw) | 340 g |
| Bread, white | 2 slices white bread, made into crumbs | 58 g |
| Butter, unsalted | 2 tbsp unsalted butter, melted | 28 g |
| Dill weed, dried | 1 tsp dried dill | 1.0 g |
| Garlic powder | ½ tsp garlic powder (not garlic salt) | 1.6 g |
| Paprika | ½ tsp paprika | 1.2 g |
| Lemon juice, fresh | 2 tbsp lemon juice | 30 g |
| Couscous, cooked | 3 cups cooked couscous, made without salt (about 1 cup dry) | 471 g |
| Olive oil | 1 tbsp olive oil | 14 g |
| Cucumber, with peel, raw | 2 cups thinly sliced cucumber | 208 g |
| Onion, raw | ¼ cup thinly sliced onion | 40 g |
| Vinegar, cider | 2 tbsp cider vinegar | 30 g |
| Sugar, granulated | 1 tsp sugar | 4.2 g |
| Black pepper, ground | ¼ tsp black pepper | 0.6 g |

## Steps

1. Make the salad first: toss the cucumber and onion with the vinegar, sugar and pepper and leave it in the fridge.
2. Heat the oven to 400 °F (200 °C). Mix the breadcrumbs, melted butter, dill, garlic powder and paprika.
3. Put the fish on a lined tray, sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the lemon juice and press the crumbs on top.
4. Bake for 12–15 minutes, until the crumbs are golden and the fish flakes easily and reaches 145 °F (63 °C).
5. Cook the couscous in water without salt, then fork in the olive oil and the rest of the lemon juice. Serve each fillet with ¾ cup couscous and ½ cup salad.

## Why it works for kidneys

- Fresh or frozen plain cod has about 66 mg sodium in 3 oz. Breaded frozen fish sticks often contain phosphate additives.
- Garlic powder adds flavor with almost no sodium (under 1 mg per ½ teaspoon); garlic salt is mostly salt.
- ¾ cup of couscous has about 70 mg potassium; a medium baked potato has about 930 mg.

## Make it fit you

- **Other fish:** tilapia or pollock work the same way, but they have more potassium: about 320–390 mg per 3 oz cooked, against about 210 mg for cod.
- **Before dialysis:** 2 oz of fish per person, with a little more couscous, if your team set a lower protein target.
- **Rice instead of couscous:** ¾ cup white rice has about the same carbohydrate.
